posts.t:
#Isles Mathew Barzal led team with 4 SOG in first game back.

Played 16:21. Had an assist, 1 TK, and ended his night winning 58% of his draws (7-of-12).
Oh Barzal almost scored a beauty. Kicks puck to his stick before a quick shot on Dostal but he makes the save. #Isles
Barzal has played 9:23 over two periods: 1A, 2 SOG, 1TK, 2-for-6 FO
Barzal with a vintage shift transition there, circling in his own zone before exploding through NZ. Gets a shot off; Dostal fights it off with the right shoulder. #Isles
Mathew Barzal recorded an assist, 1 SOG, 1 takeaway, and went 1-for-3 in FO dot in 4:42 TOI during first period. #Isles
Barzal forces turnover and then gets on 2-on-1. Tried to go short-side. #Isles
Islanders’ Mathew Barzal to make season debut vs. Ducks

threads.t: [Cavanagh] Mathew Barzal is expected to make his Islanders season debut tonight against the Anaheim Ducks, per Pete DeBoer
